name: Haruhiko
source:
A character from [url=/c29350]Tamamori's[/url] novel, "The Mysterious Man in the Basement". While he seems to be nothing more than a hallucination at first, he and [url=/c177710]Frog Man[/url] go around drinking tea, playing Go, and act as they please, as if they were real.

While Tamamori is hard on them at first, they slowly grow to become his emotional support...?

[Edited from [url=http://lookiamnotcreative.tumblr.com/post/115559777068/koshotengai-no-hashihime-the-hashihime-of-the]Tumbleweeds Escapism[/url]]

Like Tamamori, he doesn't need glasses and only wears them to look smart.
